item.title: Virginia Tech Beats Clemson 20-16 on Fourth Down Touchdown With 1:49 Left
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Ethan Grunkemeyer found Luke Reynolds from 5 yards on fourth-and-1 at Memorial Stadium, and the Hokies held off Clemson's final drive to reach six wins and bowl eligibility.

item.title: Oklahoma State Beats Colorado 57-24 as Mestemaker Throws Four Touchdowns
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Colorado led 24-23 at halftime in Stillwater and never scored again. Oklahoma State scored 34 unanswered second half points, forced four Isaac Wilson turnovers and won 57-24 behind 386 passing yards and four touchdowns from Drew Mestemaker.

item.title: Full Moon Tonight: Hunter's Moon Peaks Oct 26 at 12:12 A.M. EDT
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: The top Google Trends search in the US on Saturday was "full moon tonight." The Hunter's Moon peaks at 12:12 a.m. EDT on Monday, October 26, and Sunday evening is the best time to see it, with Saturn nearby and no telescope needed.

item.title: Colorado State Beats San Diego State 56-49 as Hejny Accounts for Five Touchdowns
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Hauss Hejny threw for 333 yards and three touchdowns and ran for two more as Colorado State held off San Diego State 56-49 in Fort Collins, surviving a 99-yard Aztec drive and an onside kick in the last two minutes.

item.title: Shooting Near FAMU Bragg Stadium After Homecoming Game, Police Confirm Victims
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Tallahassee police confirmed victims in a shooting on Perry Street near Bragg Memorial Stadium on Saturday night, hours after Florida A&M homecoming. The number of victims and their injuries were still unknown late Saturday.

item.title: Maple Leafs Beat Oilers 7-2 in Edmonton as Nylander Scores Twice
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Toronto scored four goals in the third period to beat Edmonton 7-2 at Rogers Place on Saturday night. William Nylander scored twice and Anthony Stolarz made 30 saves.

item.title: Modi in Varanasi and Bhubaneswar Sunday for Garment Factory, Air Show and RBI Centre
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visits Uttar Pradesh and Odisha on Sunday, October 25. He opens a garment factory in Varanasi, attends the Air Force display at Namo Ghat and opens the RBI Data Centre in Bhubaneswar.

item.title: Senators Beat Rangers 7-4 as Batherson Hat Trick Leads Ottawa
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Drake Batherson scored three goals and added an assist as Ottawa beat the New York Rangers 7-4 at Canadian Tire Centre on Saturday night. Jake Sanderson added a goal and two assists.

item.title: Trump Says US Could Strike Iran Maybe Tomorrow, Or Reach a Deal
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: President Trump told reporters in Florida on Saturday that the United States was thinking about striking Iran, maybe tomorrow, and in the same breath held out a big agreement. No strike and no deal had been announced by Saturday night.

item.title: Brandon Miller Scores 34 as Hornets Hold Off Heat 115-110 and Giannis Antetokounmpo Fouls Out
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Charlotte led by 23, watched Miami tie the game three times in the fourth quarter, and still closed out a 115-110 win at Spectrum Center on Saturday, with Brandon Miller scoring 34 points a night after he scored 6 in a heavy loss to Atlanta.

item.title: Joel Embiid Triple Double Leads 76ers Past Bucks 127-116 for a 3-0 Start
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Joel Embiid had 28 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists, Jaylen Brown scored 27 on his 30th birthday, and Philadelphia beat Milwaukee 127-116 in Philadelphia on Saturday to stay perfect, with LeBron James inactive.

item.title: Explosion and Fire Hit Quaker Oats Plant in Cedar Rapids, No Injuries Reported
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Firefighters contained a fire after an apparent explosion on the north side of the downtown Cedar Rapids plant on Saturday afternoon. All workers evacuated safely and no firefighters were injured, officials said.

item.title: Alisha Palmowski Wins 2026 F1 Academy Title in Austin With Second Place in Reverse Grid Race
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Second place behind Alba Larsen in Saturday's Reverse Grid Race at the Circuit of the Americas gave the 20 year old Campos Racing driver the 2026 title with three races to spare, a day after she won the Austin Opening Race.

item.title: Dalton Smith Beats Alberto Puello by Split Decision to Retain WBC Light-Welterweight Title
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Two judges scored the 12 rounds 115-113 for Smith in Sheffield and one scored it 116-112 for Puello, as Smith made a first successful defence of his 140 pound title and improved to 20-0.

item.title: Arizona State Beats Kansas State 28-17 as Freshman Mack Scores All Four Touchdowns
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Cardae Mack rushed for 159 yards on 26 carries and scored four times in Tempe, and Arizona State scored 14 unanswered points in the fourth quarter after playing three quarterbacks.

item.title: Boston College Beats Georgia Tech 49-27 With 399 Rushing Yards and Five Rushing Touchdowns
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Mason McKenzie rushed for 170 yards and Bo MacCormack III for 155 in Atlanta, and Boston College scored 37 points in the second half for its first road win of the season.

item.title: 100 Arrested in Barcelona After Rioting, Looting and Fires Around Plaza de Catalunya
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Hooded demonstrators who joined an anti-establishment rally looted shops and set more than 30 fires in central Barcelona on Saturday evening, and around a quarter of the 100 people arrested were minors.

item.title: Former Saxon Drummer Nigel Durham Dies at 61
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Saxon confirmed the death of Nigel Durham, who played drums for the British heavy metal band from 1987 to 1988 and appeared on the 1988 album Destiny. No cause of death has been disclosed.

item.title: UCF Beats No. 2 BYU 39-31 in Double Overtime for Highest Ranked Win in Program History
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Keyone Jenkins threw for 293 yards and three touchdowns in Orlando, and a roughing the kicker penalty in the second overtime gave the Knights the opening they needed to end the unbeaten run of BYU.

item.title: Oklahoma Beats Mississippi State 23-15 Behind Mateer and 283 Yards
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: John Mateer threw for 283 yards and two touchdowns with no turnovers in Starkville. Mississippi State lost quarterback Kamario Taylor to injury in the first quarter.

item.title: South Carolina Beats No. 11 Tennessee 27-24 on Walk-Off Field Goal
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Malik Orsan hit a 48-yard field goal as time expired in Columbia. The Gamecocks tied the game with 1:17 left, then recovered a fumble to set up the winner.

item.title: Volkanovski Stops Evloev in Second Round to Retain Title at UFC 333
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: The 38-year-old champion ended the fight at 4:54 of round two in Abu Dhabi, handing Movsar Evloev the first loss of his career. Petr Yan kept the bantamweight title in the co-main event.

item.title: NC State Fires Dave Doeren After 14 Seasons and Loss at Stanford
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: The Wolfpack announced the change on Saturday, one day after a 31-28 loss at Stanford dropped the team to 3-4. Running backs coach Todd Goebbel takes over on an interim basis.

item.title: Alabama Beats Texas A&M 31-20 With 14 Fourth Quarter Points, Russell Throws Three Touchdowns
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Alabama trailed 20-17 entering the fourth quarter at Bryant-Denny Stadium. Keelon Russell threw touchdown passes to Marshall Pritchett and Kaleb Edwards in the fourth, and Alabama ended back to back losses.

item.title: Minnesota Beats No. 15 Iowa 13-10 on Drzewiecki 46 Yard Field Goal as Time Expires
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Luke Drzewiecki kicked a 46 yard field goal as time expired at Huntington Bank Stadium. A 39 yard Drake Lindsey completion to Jalen Smith set up the kick after Iowa tied the game in the fourth quarter.

item.title: UCLA Beats Michigan State 28-10 at the Rose Bowl as Dieffenbach Returns to Throw 63 Yard Touchdown
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Ty Dieffenbach left with a left leg injury late in the first half and returned to throw a 63 yard touchdown pass to Brian Rowe Jr. on his first pass back. UCLA moved to 7-0 at the Rose Bowl.

item.title: Antonelli Takes Pole for United States Grand Prix in Austin, Verstappen Second
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Antonelli set 1:34.035 early in Q3 at Circuit of the Americas and no one beat it. Verstappen starts second, Hadjar third in a career best, and Antonelli can take his first title in Sunday's race.

item.title: Derrick Harriott, Jamaican Singer and Reggae Producer of The Loser, Dies at 87
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Harriott co-founded The Jiving Juniors in 1958, founded the Crystal label in 1962, produced Dennis Brown and Big Youth, and recorded one of the earliest dub albums. He died at home in Jamaica on October 24, aged 87.

item.title: Illinois Beats No. 25 Oregon 21-10 as Clayton Throws Two Touchdowns in First Start
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Oregon led 10-0 and outgained Illinois, but the Illini shut the Ducks out after half time. Aidan Laughery ran for 123 yards and a 75 yard touchdown, and Collin Dixon tied the school record with his 10th touchdown catch.

item.title: Kansas Beat Baylor 25-24 as Herold Blocks Late Field Goal for First Big 12 Win
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Isaiah Marshall ran for the go-ahead touchdown with 1:13 left and Blake Herold blocked a 45-yard field goal with 18 seconds to play as Kansas held off Baylor 25-24 in Lawrence on Saturday for its first Big 12 win of the season.

item.title: Fort Pierce, Florida: Girl, 5, Found Dead in Pond After Search
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Mayra Glory Odelus, a 5-year-old girl with autism who could not speak, vanished from her home late Saturday morning. A sheriff's dive team found her in a retention pond near the house about three hours after her father reported her missing.

item.title: Trump and Melania Trump Vote Early in Person in Palm Beach on First Day of Florida Early Voting
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: The president and first lady cast their midterm ballots shortly before 4 p.m. Eastern time at the Palm Beach County Supervisor of Elections building in West Palm Beach, switching from the mail voting the president used in March.

item.title: Ducks Beat Flyers 5-4 as Luneau and Carlsson End Losing Run in Philadelphia
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Philadelphia led 2-0 after one period on Saturday. Anaheim came back twice, then scored twice in the third period to win 5-4 and stop a five game losing streak.

item.title: Lazio Beat Parma 2-1 to Stay Top of Serie A as Taylor Scores at the Olimpico
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: The first half finished goalless in Rome on Saturday. Kenneth Taylor scored five minutes after the break, an own goal doubled the lead, and a late Parma goal made Lazio hold on for a 2-1 win.

item.title: Stephen Curry Ruled Out at Phoenix for Right Knee Management as Warriors Play Third Game in Four Days
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Golden State listed Curry out for Saturday night at the Suns, the second night of a back to back. Al Horford and Brandin Podziemski are also out, and Draymond Green is doubtful, with the Warriors at 0-2.

item.title: Pete Banaszak, Raiders Running Back Who Scored Twice in Super Bowl XI, Dies at 82
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: The Raiders announced the death on Saturday. Banaszak played his entire 13 year career with Oakland, led the NFL with 16 rushing touchdowns in 1975, and played a central role in the famous Holy Roller play.

item.title: No. 24 Northwestern Beats Rutgers 42-14 as Chiles Accounts for Five Touchdowns
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Aidan Chiles threw three touchdown passes and ran for two more at Ryan Field on Saturday. Northwestern won its fourth straight game, and Rutgers lost its quarterback in the first quarter.

item.title: No. 23 SMU Beats Cal 59-20 as Jennings Breaks Program Touchdown Record
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Cal led 20-17 at halftime in Dallas on Saturday. SMU then scored 42 points without reply, and Kevin Jennings threw the 73rd and 74th touchdown passes of his career to break the program record.

item.title: No. 1 Miami Beats Pittsburgh 52-23 as Toney Sets School Record With 16 Catches
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Malachi Toney caught 16 passes for 194 yards and three touchdowns, breaking his own Miami record, and Darian Mensah threw for 387 yards and four touchdowns in a 52-23 win at Hard Rock Stadium on Saturday.

item.title: Obama Rallies Cleveland for Brown and Acton in First Ohio Trip Since 2018
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Former President Barack Obama campaigned at Cleveland Public Auditorium on Saturday for Senate candidate Sherrod Brown and gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton, ten days before a midterm election that could decide control of the Senate.

item.title: Severe Storms Threaten New Mexico and West Texas as Flood Watches Cover the Southwest
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Forecasters warned of severe thunderstorms, large hail and a few possible tornadoes across the Southwest on Saturday into Sunday morning, with more than 2 million people under flood watches after flooding earlier this week.

item.title: Cincinnati Beat No. 8 Texas Tech 37-24 for First Top-10 Home Win Since 2006
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Cincinnati scored 21 points in the second quarter, JC French threw four touchdown passes, and the Bearcats beat unbeaten No. 8 Texas Tech 37-24 at Nippert Stadium, their first top-10 home win since 2006.

item.title: Indiana Beat Michigan 13-6 in Overtime for First Win at Ann Arbor Since 1967
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: No. 6 Indiana and Michigan played 60 minutes without a touchdown at Michigan Stadium. Josh Hoover then ran in the only score of the game in overtime, and Indiana won 13-6 for its first victory at Ann Arbor since 1967.

item.title: Valkyries Beat Dream 67-62 in Game 4 to Tie the WNBA Finals and Force Game 5
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Golden State led 42-26 at halftime and held on to beat Atlanta 67-62 in Game 4 on Saturday, tying the WNBA Finals at two games each and forcing a deciding Game 5 on Monday at Chase Center.

item.title: LSU Beat Auburn 38-17 as Leavitt Throws for 387 Yards and Four Total Touchdowns
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Sam Leavitt threw three touchdown passes and ran for a fourth, Jackson Harris caught nine passes for 178 yards and two scores, and LSU won 38-17 at Jordan-Hare Stadium on Saturday, one week after Auburn upset No. 1 Georgia.

item.title: Oil at $116.72 and a Fed Decision Wednesday: What Breaks First
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Brent settled at $116.72, its highest since April, after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia. With the Fed deciding rates on Wednesday and midterms on November 3, the premium now runs into monetary policy and politics at the same time.

item.title: Britt McHenry Resigns State Department Job After Drink-Throwing Video
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: The former ESPN broadcaster confirmed she signed a resignation letter after TMZ video showed her throwing a drink at a heckling fan at the Wizards and Bucks game on Wednesday, one day after a promotion.

item.title: Ontario Education Workers Rally in Five Cities Over School Funding
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Five education unions representing 255,000 workers staged the same rally at the same hour in Toronto, Ottawa, London, Sudbury and Thunder Bay, citing a $6.5 billion funding gap days before municipal elections.

item.title: Appeal Court Rules UNDRIP Act Does Not Bind Canada's Nuclear Regulator
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: A unanimous Federal Court of Appeal decision says the declaration act sets a framework for government, not a duty for the regulator that approved the Chalk River waste facility, overturning a 2025 ruling that had ordered new consultations.

item.title: JD(U) Expels Mokama MLA Anant Singh and Wife Neelam Devi for Six Years
item.author: The Orbit Post
item.description: Bihar's ruling party cancelled the couple's membership with immediate effect on Saturday after Singh campaigned for a rival candidate in the Legislative Council elections, and it has asked the Assembly Speaker to disqualify him as an MLA.
